content:
Extract the invoice data from the document below into JSON with exactly this schema:

{
  "vendor_name": "string",
  "invoice_number": "string",
  "invoice_date": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "due_date": "YYYY-MM-DD or null if not applicable",
  "currency": "3-letter ISO code",
  "subtotal": 0.00,
  "tax_amount": 0.00,
  "total": 0.00,
  "line_items": [
    {"description": "string", "quantity": 0, "unit_price": 0.00, "amount": 0.00}
  ]
}

Note: subtotal means all pre-tax charges (including shipping and after discounts).

Return only the JSON object, nothing else.

DOCUMENT:
CASCADE WEB STUDIO
"Websites that work as hard as you do"
hello@cascadeweb.example | Bend, Oregon

Invoice #CWS-341
Issued: May 20, 2025
Payment due: June 19, 2025
All amounts in USD.

Client: High Desert Coffee Roasters

------------------------------------------------------------------
 SERVICE                            QTY    RATE          AMOUNT
------------------------------------------------------------------
 Monthly design retainer (May)       1     1,200.00      1,200.00
 Managed hosting (monthly x12)      12        15.00        180.00
 Loyalty discount (10%)              1      -138.00       -138.00
------------------------------------------------------------------
                                        Subtotal:        1,242.00
                                        Tax:  not applicable (services)
                                        AMOUNT DUE:      1,242.00

Please pay by bank transfer. Late payments accrue 1.5%/month.

```json
{
  "vendor_name": "CASCADE WEB STUDIO",
  "invoice_number": "CWS-341",
  "invoice_date": "2025-05-20",
  "due_date": "2025-06-19",
  "currency": "USD",
  "subtotal": 1242.00,
  "tax_amount": 0.00,
  "total": 1242.00,
  "line_items": [
    {"description": "Monthly design retainer (May)", "quantity": 1, "unit_price": 1200.00, "amount": 1200.00},
    {"description": "Managed hosting (monthly x12)", "quantity": 12, "unit_price": 15.00, "amount": 180.00},
    {"description": "Loyalty discount (10%)", "quantity": 1, "unit_price": -138.00, "amount": -138.00}
  ]
}
```
